assertions.source: sympy: wtNumer(q,z_C)=0 only at q=1 or root(x^3+2x^2+x-1); neither on 1 < q < plastic

description: bean qou-cds1: the negative (1^3) Ocneanu weight is an INTERVAL fact, not a point fact. wtNumer = (z-q)((q^2+1)z-q^3) is an upward parabola with roots exactly the two admissible Markov parameters z_D < q, so it is negative on ALL of (z_D, q) (width q/(q^2+1) = 0.497 at the pin) and positive outside. DEFLATES two prior readings of its value at a point — y_(1^3)(z=1) = -0.01399 (qbeta-admissibility-is-a-magnitude, 2026-08-30) and y_(1^3)(z*) = -0.014131 (PR #6340, mine) — which are one fact and carry no information beyond z in (z_D, q). ADDS: z_C < z_D for every q > 1, so convention C's Markov parameter is inadmissible on the whole window (sympy: wtNumer(q,z_C)=0 only at q=1 or the root of x^3+2x^2+x-1), and the counit z=1 lies on the OPPOSITE side of the admissible set from convention C — the ladder's base never descended to the two-row quotient under either convention. Lean-proved sorry-free: zD_lt_self, sub_zD_eq, wtNumer_neg_of_between, wtNumer_pos_of_lt_zD, one_not_root_of_interval (one_not_root as a corollary), zC_lt_zD, zC_not_root. Scope-(a), deflationary; nothing wired; the decay base is NOT excluded here (DecayFibreBarParity: the cap is the mass channel's forcing).

wtNumer_zC_zero_only_at: ComplexRootOf(Add(Pow(Symbol('x'), Integer(3)), Mul(Integer(2), Pow(Symbol('x'), Integer(2))), Symbol('x'), Integer(-1)), Integer(0))
